title: A measured independent-output partition was missing from the callable squared-distance tactics

evidence.locator: source_turn=7 manual submit, retained lowered_source and fresh confirmatory candidate_evaluated receipt

observation: The R128 K256 N32 confirmed candidate keeps full K resident but partitions N into groups of four, preserving FP32 difference-before-square. Its fresh paired medians are 15.36/4.608 us against the fixed K64 loop, speedup 3.3333x. The callable tactic only tiled K, leaving this independent-output mechanism to manual construction.
proposed_change: Expose explicit guarded tile_squared_difference_outputs using the same exact graph/storage/access domain as K tiling. Modify N program ownership, matching centroid/load and output/store slices, and register shapes together. Keep full K reduction, public ABI, dtypes and primitive analyses unchanged. Caller still chooses parameters; there is no physical maxnreg guarantee or implicit lowering rewrite.

verified_by.scope: Fresh Compiler-generated output_tile=4, R128 K256 N32, all five original validation distributions; unchanged oracle and fixed K64 baseline, 250 samples per arm, ten pairs, 10/10 wins, 15.36/4.608 us medians; separate profiler passed. Local-serialized GPU0, external activity not excluded. No E/P, held-out shape or generalization claim.

software_verification.tests: 4 rewrite tests plus shared Compiler gates, independent review of input guards, output masks/ownership, renamed buffers, declaration order and K=1; 180 unchanged Corpus cases passed

promotion_disposition: Promoted to explicit Compiler rewrite with exact graph/storage/access guards. Fresh pass-generated single-shape C550 correctness, paired measurement and profiler qualification passed; caller selects output_tile. Physical maxnreg enforcement and cross-shape transfer remain unqualified.
